decisions.reason: The received Hebrew text reads "a valley". The ancient Greek translation reads "Gath", which would pair with Ekron as at the end of the verse. This note is given from general knowledge; reviewers must check it against a critical edition.

decisions.choice: Shaaraim: a town of Judah's lowland
decisions.reason: Shaaraim is listed with Socoh and Azekah (Joshua 15:35-36). The road from there led west toward the Philistine cities.

decisions.choice: Gath and Ekron: Philistine cities
decisions.reason: These were two of the five Philistine cities (6:17), on the coastal plain west of the Valley of Elah. Israel chased the Philistines back to their own gates.

decisions.choice: Israel and Judah: the whole people
decisions.reason: Judah is named alongside Israel, as in 11:8 and 15:4, perhaps because the battle was fought in Judah's land (verse 1).

decisions.choice: as far as; all the way to
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the Hebrew idiom "until your coming to".

decisions.choice: Shaaraïm
decisions.reason: A name not in the terms table, in the usual French transcription; Eqrôn and Gath as the Samuel terms note.

source.text: וַיָּשֻׁ֨בוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִדְּלֹ֖ק אַחֲרֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַיָּשֹׁ֖סּוּ אֶת־מַחֲנֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And returned [the] sons of Israel from hotly pursuing after [the] Philistines and plundered their camps.

en.L: And the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel returned from hotly pursuing the Philistines and plundered their camps.
en.B: When the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} came back from chasing the Philistines, they plundered their camp.
en.R: After the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} came back from chasing the Philistines, they took everything of value from the Philistine camp.

es.L: Y volvieron los hijos de Israel de perseguir encarnizadamente a los filisteos, y saquearon sus campamentos.
es.B: Cuando los israelitas regresaron de perseguir a los filisteos, saquearon su campamento.
es.R: Después de perseguir a los filisteos, los israelitas regresaron y se llevaron todo lo de valor que había en el campamento filisteo.

fr.L: Et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël revinrent de leur poursuite ardente des Philistins, et ils pillèrent leurs camps.
fr.B: Quand les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} revinrent de la poursuite des Philistins, ils pillèrent leur camp.
fr.R: Quand les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} sont revenus après avoir poursuivi les Philistins, ils ont pris tout ce qui avait de la valeur dans le camp philistin.

sw.L: Wana wa Israeli wakarudi kutoka kuwafuatia Wafilisti kwa nguvu, wakateka nyara kambi zao.
sw.B: Waisraeli waliporudi kutoka kuwafukuza Wafilisti, wakateka nyara kambi yao.
sw.R: Waisraeli waliporudi kutoka kuwafukuza Wafilisti, wakachukua kila kitu cha thamani kutoka katika kambi ya Wafilisti.

vi.L: Con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên trở về sau khi hăng hái đuổi theo người Phi-li-tin, và cướp phá các trại quân của họ.
vi.B: Khi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên trở về sau cuộc truy đuổi người Phi-li-tin, họ cướp phá trại quân của chúng.
vi.R: Sau khi đuổi theo người Phi-li-tin trở về, dân Y-sơ-ra-ên lấy hết mọi thứ có giá trị trong trại quân Phi-li-tin.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 자손이 블레셋 사람들을 맹렬히 뒤쫓다가 돌아와서 그들의 진영을 약탈했다.
ko.B: 이스라엘 사람들은 블레셋 사람들을 뒤쫓다가 돌아와서 그들의 진영을 약탈했다.
ko.R: 이스라엘 사람들은 블레셋 사람들을 뒤쫓다가 돌아와서, 블레셋 진영에서 값나가는 것을 모두 가져갔다.

pt.L: E os filhos de Israel voltaram de perseguir ardorosamente os filisteus e saquearam os seus acampamentos.
pt.B: Quando os israelitas voltaram da perseguição aos filisteus, saquearam o acampamento deles.
pt.R: Depois que os israelitas voltaram de perseguir os filisteus, pegaram tudo o que tinha valor no acampamento dos filisteus.

decisions.choice: hotly pursuing: chasing fiercely
decisions.reason: The verb means to burn or to pursue hotly, a hard and eager chase.

decisions.choice: plundered: took the goods left behind
decisions.reason: The fleeing army left its camp, and Israel took the spoil.

decisions.choice: took everything of value
decisions.reason: Readable explains "plundered".

decisions.choice: les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d'Israël (L); les {{gender:Israélites|fils d'Israël}} (B, R)
alternatives: les fils d'Israël without a setting
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch note sets for "the sons of Israel": the people as a whole, men and women, is the default, and the traditional wording the alternative.

decisions.choice: los hijos de Israel (L); los israelitas (B, R), without a gender span
alternatives: a gender span, as the English has
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch note sets: Spanish “hijos” already includes daughters, so no gender span is needed where the English has one. Recorded once for this block.

decisions.choice: "wana wa Israeli" (L); "Waisraeli" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch note: "wana" already includes daughters, and "Waisraeli" names the people, so the English gender setting has nothing to change in Swahili.

decisions.choice: "이스라엘 자손" (L) and "이스라엘 사람들" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: Korean "자손" and "사람들" already include women and men, so Korean has no second wording for the English "children / sons" setting.

decisions.choice: no gender span: "con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên" (L), "dân Y-sơ-ra-ên" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "con cháu" and "dân" already include men and women, so there is only one wording; this holds through the block.

decisions.choice: os filhos de Israel (L); os israelitas (B, R); no gender setting
alternatives: os filhos e as filhas de Israel
decisions.reason: As throughout the Portuguese Old Testament, "filhos" already takes in daughters and "israelitas" names the people, so Portuguese has no second wording for the gender setting the English uses here.

source.text: וַיִּקַּ֤ח דָּוִד֙ אֶת־רֹ֣אשׁ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֔י וַיְבִאֵ֖הוּ יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְאֶת־כֵּלָ֖יו שָׂ֥ם בְּאָהֳלֽוֹ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And took David the head of the Philistine and brought it [to] Jerusalem, and his weapons he put in his tent.

en.L: And David took the head of the Philistine and brought it [to] Jerusalem, and he put his weapons in his tent.
en.B: David took the Philistine's head and brought it to Jerusalem, and he put the Philistine's weapons in his own tent.
en.R: David took Goliath's head and brought it to Jerusalem. He kept Goliath's weapons in his own tent.

es.L: Y tomó David la cabeza del filisteo y la llevó [a] Jerusalén, y sus armas las puso en su tienda.
es.B: David tomó la cabeza del filisteo y la llevó a Jerusalén, y guardó las armas del filisteo en su propia tienda.
es.R: David tomó la cabeza de Goliat y la llevó a Jerusalén. Las armas de Goliat las guardó en su propia tienda.

fr.L: Et David prit la tête du Philistin et l’apporta à Jérusalem, et il mit ses armes dans sa tente.
fr.B: David prit la tête du Philistin et l’apporta à Jérusalem, et il déposa les armes du Philistin dans sa propre tente.
fr.R: David a pris la tête de Goliath et il l’a apportée à Jérusalem. Il a gardé les armes de Goliath dans sa propre tente.

sw.L: Daudi akakichukua kichwa cha Mfilisti, akakileta Yerusalemu, na silaha zake akaziweka hemani mwake.
sw.B: Daudi akakichukua kichwa cha Mfilisti, akakileta Yerusalemu, na silaha za Mfilisti akaziweka katika hema yake mwenyewe.
sw.R: Daudi akakichukua kichwa cha Goliathi, akakileta Yerusalemu. Silaha za Goliathi akaziweka katika hema yake mwenyewe.

vi.L: Đa-vít lấy đầu người Phi-li-tin đem [đến] Giê-ru-sa-lem, và để vũ khí của hắn trong lều mình.
vi.B: Đa-vít lấy đầu người Phi-li-tin đem về Giê-ru-sa-lem, còn vũ khí của hắn thì cậu để trong lều của mình.
vi.R: Đa-vít lấy đầu Gô-li-át đem về Giê-ru-sa-lem. Cậu giữ vũ khí của Gô-li-át trong lều của mình.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 그 블레셋 사람의 머리를 가져다가 예루살렘으로 가져갔고, 그의 무기는 자기 장막에 두었다.
ko.B: 다윗은 그 블레셋 사람의 머리를 예루살렘으로 가져갔고, 그 사람의 무기는 자기 장막에 두었다.
ko.R: 다윗은 골리앗의 머리를 예루살렘으로 가져갔다. 그리고 골리앗의 무기는 자기 장막에 두었다.

pt.L: E Davi tomou a cabeça do filisteu e a levou a Jerusalém, e pôs as armas dele na sua tenda.
pt.B: Davi pegou a cabeça do filisteu e a levou para Jerusalém, e guardou as armas do filisteu na sua própria tenda.
pt.R: Davi pegou a cabeça de Golias e a levou para Jerusalém. As armas de Golias, ele guardou na sua própria tenda.

decisions.choice: Jerusalem: a city not yet in Israel's hands
decisions.reason: Jerusalem was held by the Jebusites until David captured it as king (2 Samuel 5:6-9). The verse may look ahead to that time, telling where the trophy was finally kept, or Israelites may already have lived there beside the Jebusites (Judges 1:8, 21). The text does not explain.

decisions.choice: his tent: David's own tent
decisions.reason: The word can mean a soldier's tent or a dwelling. David kept the weapons as his spoil. Goliath's sword later appears at the sanctuary at Nob (21:10), so David may have given it there afterward.

decisions.choice: the Philistine's weapons; Goliath's weapons
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make clear whose weapons these were.

source.text: וְכִרְא֨וֹת שָׁא֜וּל אֶת־דָּוִ֗ד יֹצֵא֙ לִקְרַ֣את הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֔י אָמַ֗ר אֶל־אַבְנֵר֙ שַׂ֣ר הַצָּבָ֔א בֶּן־מִי־זֶ֥ה הַנַּ֖עַר אַבְנֵ֑ר וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אַבְנֵ֔ר חֵֽי־נַפְשְׁךָ֥ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אִם־יָדָֽעְתִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: And when saw Saul David going out to meet the Philistine, he said to Abner, commander of the army, Whose son [is] this youth, Abner? And said Abner, [By the] life of your soul, O king, if I know.

en.L: And when Saul saw David going out to meet the Philistine, he said to Abner, the commander of the army, "Whose son [is] this youth, Abner?" And Abner said, "[As] your soul lives, O king, I do not know."
en.B: When Saul had watched David going out to meet the Philistine, he had asked Abner, the commander of the army, "Whose son is this young man, Abner?" Abner replied, "As surely as you live, O king, I do not know."
en.R: Earlier, when Saul saw David going out to fight the Philistine, he had asked Abner, the army commander, "Abner, whose son is this young man?" Abner answered, "Your Majesty, I promise you that I do not know."

es.L: Y cuando Saúl vio a David que salía al encuentro del filisteo, dijo a Abner, jefe del ejército: «¿De quién [es] hijo este muchacho, Abner?». Y dijo Abner: «[Por] la vida de tu alma, oh rey, que no [lo] sé».
es.B: Cuando Saúl había visto a David salir al encuentro del filisteo, le había preguntado a Abner, el jefe del ejército: «Abner, ¿de quién es hijo este muchacho?». Abner le había respondido: «Tan cierto como que vives, oh rey, no lo sé».
es.R: Antes, cuando Saúl vio a David salir a pelear contra el filisteo, le había preguntado a Abner, el jefe del ejército: «Abner, ¿de quién es hijo este joven?». Abner le contestó: «Rey mío, te aseguro que no lo sé».

fr.L: Et quand Saül vit David sortir à la rencontre du Philistin, il dit à Abner, le chef de l’armée : « De qui ce garçon [est-il] le fils, Abner ? » Et Abner dit : « [Aussi vrai que] ton âme est vivante, ô roi, je ne le sais pas. »
fr.B: Quand Saül avait vu David sortir à la rencontre du Philistin, il avait demandé à Abner, le chef de l’armée : « Abner, de qui ce jeune homme est-il le fils ? » Abner avait répondu : « Aussi vrai que tu es vivant, ô roi, je ne le sais pas. »
fr.R: Plus tôt, quand Saül avait vu David partir se battre contre le Philistin, il avait demandé à Abner, le chef de l’armée : « Abner, de qui ce jeune homme est-il le fils ? » Abner avait répondu : « Ô roi, je te le jure, je ne le sais pas. »

sw.L: Sauli alipomwona Daudi akitoka kwenda kukutana na Mfilisti, akamwambia Abneri, jemadari wa jeshi, "Kijana huyu ni mwana wa nani, Abneri?" Abneri akasema, "Kama nafsi yako iishivyo, Ee mfalme, sijui."
sw.B: Sauli alipokuwa amemtazama Daudi akitoka kwenda kukutana na Mfilisti, alikuwa amemwuliza Abneri, mkuu wa jeshi, "Abneri, kijana huyu ni mwana wa nani?" Abneri akajibu, "Kama uishivyo, Ee mfalme, sijui."
sw.R: Kabla ya hapo, Sauli alipomwona Daudi akitoka kwenda kupigana na Mfilisti, alikuwa amemwuliza Abneri, mkuu wa jeshi, "Abneri, kijana huyu ni mwana wa nani?" Abneri akajibu, "Mtukufu mfalme, nakuapia kwamba sijui."

vi.L: Khi Sau-lơ thấy Đa-vít đi ra đối đầu với người Phi-li-tin, ông nói với Áp-ne, tướng chỉ huy quân đội: "Áp-ne, đứa trẻ này [là] con trai của ai?" Áp-ne nói: "Tâu vua, thật như linh hồn vua đang sống, tôi không biết."
vi.B: Lúc Sau-lơ nhìn Đa-vít đi ra đối đầu với người Phi-li-tin, vua đã hỏi Áp-ne, tướng chỉ huy quân đội: "Áp-ne, chàng trai này là con ai vậy?" Áp-ne đáp: "Tâu bệ hạ, thật như bệ hạ đang sống, tôi không biết."
vi.R: Trước đó, khi Sau-lơ thấy Đa-vít đi ra đánh người Phi-li-tin, vua đã hỏi Áp-ne, tướng chỉ huy quân đội: "Áp-ne, chàng trai này là con ai vậy?" Áp-ne đáp: "Tâu đức vua, tôi xin thề là tôi không biết."

ko.L: 그리고 사울은 다윗이 그 블레셋 사람을 맞으러 나가는 것을 보았을 때, 군대 사령관 아브넬에게 말했다. "아브넬아, 이 젊은이는 누구의 아들이냐?" 그러자 아브넬이 말했다. "임금님, 임금님의 목숨을 두고 [맹세하는데], 저는 모릅니다."
ko.B: 앞서 사울은 다윗이 그 블레셋 사람을 맞으러 나가는 것을 보고, 군대 사령관 아브넬에게 물었다. "아브넬아, 저 젊은이가 누구의 아들이냐?" 아브넬이 대답했다. "임금님, 임금님의 목숨을 두고 맹세하지만 저는 모릅니다."
ko.R: 그보다 앞서 사울은 다윗이 블레셋 사람과 싸우러 나가는 것을 보고, 군대 사령관 아브넬에게 물었다. "아브넬아, 저 젊은이는 누구의 아들이냐?" 아브넬이 대답했다. "임금님, 정말로 저는 모릅니다."

pt.L: E, quando Saul viu Davi saindo ao encontro do filisteu, disse a Abner, o comandante do exército: "De quem [é] filho este moço, Abner?" E Abner disse: "[Tão certo como] vive a sua alma, ó rei, eu não sei."
pt.B: Quando Saul tinha visto Davi sair para enfrentar o filisteu, tinha perguntado a Abner, o comandante do exército: "Abner, de quem é filho esse rapaz?" Abner respondeu: "Tão certo como o rei vive, eu não sei."
pt.R: Antes, quando Saul viu Davi saindo para lutar com o filisteu, tinha perguntado a Abner, o comandante do exército: "Abner, de quem é filho esse rapaz?" Abner respondeu: "Majestade, juro que não sei."

decisions.choice: when Saul saw David going out: a look back
decisions.reason: Verses 55-56 go back to the moment before the fight, when David went out to meet Goliath. Verses 57-58 return to the time after it.

decisions.choice: whose son is this youth?: Saul asks about David's family
decisions.reason: Saul had promised the winner his daughter and freedom for his father's house (verse 25), so he needed to know who the young man's father was. Yet in 16:18-23 Saul had already sent to Jesse and taken David into his service. The story does not explain this; the account may come from a separate telling (see verse 12), or Saul may not have connected the shepherd boy with his musician.

decisions.choice: as your soul lives ... I do not know: an oath
decisions.reason: Abner swears by the king's life. In such oaths "if I know" means "I do not know": the curse that would follow if it were false is left unsaid.

decisions.choice: verses 55-58 are part of the received Hebrew text
decisions.reason: Verses 55-58, with the opening verses of chapter 18, are missing from the shorter text of the ancient Greek translation; see verse 12.

decisions.choice: had watched ... had asked; Earlier
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make clear that these words look back to before the fight.

decisions.choice: Your Majesty
decisions.reason: Readable uses a modern form of address to a king.

decisions.choice: Aussi vrai que ton âme est vivante (L); Aussi vrai que tu es vivant (B)
decisions.reason: The oath by the king's life (m3) takes the form the Samuel terms note sets for "As the LORD lives"; Readable says "je te le jure", as the English "I promise you".

decisions.choice: plus-que-parfait ("avait vu", "avait demandé")
decisions.reason: Verses 55-56 look back to before the fight (m1); the French pluperfect marks the step back, as the English "had watched ... had asked" (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: Rey mío
decisions.reason: The English Readable says “Your Majesty” (r-en-2). Spanish “Majestad” would call for “usted”, which this translation does not use; “Rey mío” keeps the respect with “tú”, as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: "jemadari wa jeshi" (L); "mkuu wa jeshi" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the terms note, for the commander of the army through this block.

decisions.choice: "Mtukufu mfalme" (R)
decisions.reason: Readable uses the respectful Swahili address to a king for the English "Your Majesty"; Literal and Balanced keep "Ee mfalme".

decisions.choice: "Tâu vua" (L), "Tâu bệ hạ" (B), "Tâu đức vua" (R) for "O king"
decisions.reason: "Tâu" is the word for speaking to a king; the titles follow the Samuel terms note for each level.

decisions.choice: "앞서" / "그보다 앞서" (earlier) at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: Verses 55-58 look back to before the fight (meaning decision m1); Korean marks the step back in time with a word, since its past tense has no pluperfect.

decisions.choice: "임금님의 목숨을 두고 맹세하는데" (L, B); Readable "정말로" (truly)
decisions.reason: Abner swears by the king's life (meaning decision m3); Readable gives the force of the oath in plain words, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Tão certo como o rei vive (B); Majestade (R)
decisions.reason: Abner swears by the king's life addressing him in the third person, "o rei", the courtly address to a king; Readable says "Majestade", as the English says "Your Majesty".

source.text: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ שְׁאַ֣ל אַתָּ֔ה בֶּן־מִי־זֶ֖ה הָעָֽלֶם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And said the king, Ask you whose son this young man [is].

en.L: And the king said, "You ask whose son this young man [is]."
en.B: The king said, "Find out whose son this young man is."
en.R: The king said, "Find out who this young man's father is."

es.L: Y dijo el rey: «Pregunta tú de quién [es] hijo este joven».
es.B: El rey dijo: «Averigua de quién es hijo este joven».
es.R: El rey dijo: «Averigua quién es el padre de este joven».

fr.L: Et le roi dit : « Toi, demande de qui ce jeune homme [est] le fils. »
fr.B: Le roi avait dit : « Renseigne-toi pour savoir de qui ce jeune homme est le fils. »
fr.R: Le roi avait dit : « Va savoir qui est le père de ce jeune homme. »

sw.L: Mfalme akasema, "Wewe uliza kijana huyu ni mwana wa nani."
sw.B: Mfalme akasema, "Tafuta ujue kijana huyu ni mwana wa nani."
sw.R: Mfalme akasema, "Tafuta ujue baba yake kijana huyu ni nani."

vi.L: Vua nói: "Ngươi hãy hỏi xem chàng trai trẻ này [là] con ai."
vi.B: Vua nói: "Hãy đi hỏi xem chàng trai trẻ này là con ai."
vi.R: Vua nói: "Hãy tìm xem cha của chàng trai trẻ này là ai."

ko.L: 그리고 왕이 말했다. "이 젊은이가 누구의 아들인지 네가 물어보아라."
ko.B: 왕이 말했다. "저 젊은이가 누구의 아들인지 알아보아라."
ko.R: 왕이 말했다. "저 젊은이의 아버지가 누구인지 알아보아라."

pt.L: E o rei disse: "Pergunte você de quem [é] filho este jovem."
pt.B: O rei disse: "Descubra de quem é filho esse jovem."
pt.R: O rei disse: "Descubra quem é o pai desse jovem."

decisions.choice: young man: a youth of marriageable age
decisions.reason: This is a different word from the "youth" of verse 55. It names a young man grown to manhood.

decisions.choice: ask you: you find out
decisions.reason: The added pronoun stresses that Abner himself is to find out.

source.text: וּכְשׁ֣וּב דָּוִ֗ד מֵֽהַכּוֹת֙ אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֔י וַיִּקַּ֤ח אֹתוֹ֙ אַבְנֵ֔ר וַיְבִאֵ֖הוּ לִפְנֵ֣י שָׁא֑וּל וְרֹ֥אשׁ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖י בְּיָדֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And when returned David from striking down the Philistine, took him Abner and brought him before Saul, and the head of the Philistine [was] in his hand.

en.L: And when David returned from striking down the Philistine, Abner took him and brought him before Saul, with the head of the Philistine in his hand.
en.B: As soon as David came back from killing the Philistine, Abner took him and brought him to Saul, with the Philistine's head still in his hand.
en.R: As soon as David came back from killing Goliath, Abner brought him to Saul. David was still holding Goliath's head.

es.L: Y cuando volvió David de matar al filisteo, lo tomó Abner y lo llevó delante de Saúl, con la cabeza del filisteo en su mano.
es.B: En cuanto David volvió de matar al filisteo, Abner lo tomó y lo llevó ante Saúl, con la cabeza del filisteo todavía en la mano.
es.R: En cuanto David volvió de matar a Goliat, Abner lo llevó ante Saúl. David todavía tenía en la mano la cabeza de Goliat.

fr.L: Et quand David revint après avoir frappé le Philistin, Abner le prit et l’amena devant Saül, et la tête du Philistin [était] dans sa main.
fr.B: Dès que David revint après avoir tué le Philistin, Abner le prit et le conduisit devant Saül ; David tenait encore à la main la tête du Philistin.
fr.R: Dès que David est revenu après avoir tué Goliath, Abner l’a amené à Saül. David tenait encore la tête de Goliath à la main.

sw.L: Daudi aliporudi kutoka kumpiga Mfilisti, Abneri akamchukua, akamleta mbele ya Sauli, na kichwa cha Mfilisti mkononi mwake.
sw.B: Mara Daudi aliporudi kutoka kumwua Mfilisti, Abneri akamchukua, akamleta kwa Sauli, akiwa bado ameshika kichwa cha Mfilisti mkononi mwake.
sw.R: Mara Daudi aliporudi kutoka kumwua Goliathi, Abneri akamleta kwa Sauli. Daudi alikuwa bado ameshika kichwa cha Goliathi.

vi.L: Khi Đa-vít trở về sau khi đánh hạ người Phi-li-tin, Áp-ne đem cậu đến trước mặt Sau-lơ, đầu người Phi-li-tin [vẫn] trong tay cậu.
vi.B: Ngay khi Đa-vít trở về sau khi giết người Phi-li-tin, Áp-ne đưa cậu đến gặp Sau-lơ, tay cậu vẫn còn cầm đầu người Phi-li-tin.
vi.R: Ngay khi Đa-vít giết Gô-li-át trở về, Áp-ne dẫn cậu đến gặp Sau-lơ. Đa-vít vẫn còn cầm đầu Gô-li-át trong tay.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 그 블레셋 사람을 쳐 죽이고 돌아왔을 때, 아브넬이 그를 데리고 사울 앞으로 갔는데, 그 블레셋 사람의 머리가 그의 손에 [있었다].
ko.B: 다윗이 그 블레셋 사람을 죽이고 돌아오자마자, 아브넬이 그를 데리고 사울에게 갔다. 다윗의 손에는 아직도 그 블레셋 사람의 머리가 들려 있었다.
ko.R: 다윗이 골리앗을 죽이고 돌아오자마자, 아브넬은 다윗을 사울에게 데려갔다. 다윗은 아직도 골리앗의 머리를 들고 있었다.

pt.L: E, quando Davi voltou de ferir o filisteu, Abner o tomou e o levou diante de Saul, com a cabeça do filisteu na sua mão.
pt.B: Assim que Davi voltou depois de matar o filisteu, Abner o pegou e o levou a Saul, ainda com a cabeça do filisteu na mão.
pt.R: Assim que Davi voltou depois de matar Golias, Abner o levou a Saul. Davi ainda estava segurando a cabeça de Golias.

decisions.choice: in his hand: David's hand
decisions.reason: David comes before the king still holding the giant's head, the proof of his victory.

decisions.choice: Goliath
decisions.reason: Readable uses the name instead of "the Philistine".

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ שָׁא֔וּל בֶּן־מִ֥י אַתָּ֖ה הַנָּ֑עַר וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔ד בֶּֽן־עַבְדְּךָ֥ יִשַׁ֖י בֵּ֥ית הַלַּחְמִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And said to him Saul, Whose son [are] you, young man? And said David, [The] son of your servant Jesse the Bethlehemite.

en.L: And Saul said to him, "Whose son [are] you, young man?" And David said, "[The] son of your servant Jesse the Bethlehemite."
en.B: Saul asked him, "Whose son are you, young man?" "The son of your servant Jesse of Bethlehem," David answered.
en.R: Saul asked him, "Young man, who is your father?" David answered, "I am the son of your servant Jesse, from Bethlehem."

es.L: Y le dijo Saúl: «¿De quién [eres] hijo, muchacho?». Y dijo David: «Hijo de tu siervo Isaí el belenita».
es.B: Saúl le preguntó: «¿De quién eres hijo, muchacho?». «Soy hijo de tu siervo Isaí, de Belén», respondió David.
es.R: Saúl le preguntó: «Joven, ¿quién es tu padre?». David le contestó: «Soy hijo de tu siervo Isaí, de Belén».

fr.L: Et Saül lui dit : « De qui [es]-tu le fils, jeune homme ? » Et David dit : « [Le] fils de ton serviteur Jessé le Bethléémite. »
fr.B: Saül lui demanda : « De qui es-tu le fils, jeune homme ? » « Je suis le fils de ton serviteur Jessé, de Bethléem », répondit David.
fr.R: Saül lui a demandé : « Jeune homme, qui est ton père ? » David a répondu : « Je suis le fils de ton serviteur Jessé, de Bethléem. »

sw.L: Sauli akamwambia, "Wewe [ni] mwana wa nani, kijana?" Daudi akasema, "Mwana wa mtumishi wako Yese Mbethlehemu."
sw.B: Sauli akamwuliza, "Kijana, wewe ni mwana wa nani?" Daudi akajibu, "Mwana wa mtumishi wako Yese wa Bethlehemu."
sw.R: Sauli akamwuliza, "Kijana, baba yako ni nani?" Daudi akajibu, "Mimi ni mwana wa mtumishi wako Yese, wa Bethlehemu."

vi.L: Sau-lơ nói với cậu: "Hỡi chàng trai trẻ, ngươi [là] con ai?" Đa-vít nói: "[Tôi là] con của Gie-sê, đầy tớ của vua, người Bết-lê-hem."
vi.B: Sau-lơ hỏi cậu: "Chàng trai trẻ, ngươi là con ai?" Đa-vít đáp: "Thưa, tôi là con của Gie-sê ở Bết-lê-hem, đầy tớ của bệ hạ."
vi.R: Sau-lơ hỏi cậu: "Chàng trai trẻ, cha ngươi là ai?" Đa-vít đáp: "Tôi là con của Gie-sê, đầy tớ của đức vua, ở Bết-lê-hem."

ko.L: 그리고 사울이 그에게 말했다. "젊은이야, 너는 누구의 아들이냐?" 그러자 다윗이 말했다. "베들레헴 사람인 임금님의 종 이새의 아들입니다."
ko.B: 사울이 그에게 물었다. "젊은이야, 너는 누구의 아들이냐?" 다윗이 대답했다. "베들레헴에 사는 임금님의 종 이새의 아들입니다."
ko.R: 사울이 그에게 물었다. "젊은이야, 네 아버지는 누구냐?" 다윗이 대답했다. "저는 베들레헴에 사는 임금님의 종 이새의 아들입니다."

pt.L: E Saul lhe disse: "De quem [é] filho você, moço?" E Davi disse: "[Sou] filho do seu servo Jessé, o belemita."
pt.B: Saul lhe perguntou: "De quem você é filho, rapaz?" "Sou filho do seu servo Jessé, de Belém", respondeu Davi.
pt.R: Saul perguntou a ele: "Rapaz, quem é o seu pai?" Davi respondeu: "Sou filho do seu servo Jessé, de Belém."

decisions.choice: your servant Jesse: a courteous form
decisions.reason: David speaks of his father as the king's servant, the respectful way for a subject to name someone to the king (verse 32).

decisions.choice: Jesse the Bethlehemite
decisions.reason: The chapter ends where David's story began, with Jesse of Bethlehem (16:1, 18). Saul now knows the family of the man who will one day take his place.

decisions.choice: who is your father?
decisions.reason: Readable asks the question in everyday words.
